name: Lang Nguyen
biography: wanted to design spacecraft as a kid in Ukraine, but got sidetracked growing up. His first real programming experience was writing demos for the NES emulator in 6502 assembly. He thus got hooked on low-level hacking, electronics, reverse engineering, and the intersection thereof. His projects have included reverse engineering the bytecode format used in obscure BASIC compilers, a homegrown method for drawing surface-mount PCBs, and a fast PDF reader for the iPhone. The last few months he spent playing with FPGAs. He is now attending UCLA as a CS&E major.
